statement: Capers was born and raised in Charleston, SC. Being an outdoorsman, he has spent much of his life hunting and fishing in the Ace Basin of South Carolina. Self-taught, he has gained inspiration from his surroundings and paints the beauty in impressionistic landscapes inspired by the Lowcountry.
